earlier_scan.source_named: Wetshemongo Kamomba, Michel. 1996 (study of Hamba, per Glottolog refs); also Jacobs, John 1962/1964; Motingea Mangulu 1989.
earlier_scan.note: Bantu C.80 (Tetela group) memoire-type descriptions exist per Glottolog; none online.

sources.citation: Labaere, Hubert Raphael. 2001. Guthrie et la Zone C. Traduction et commentaire du point de vue otetela C71. Annales Aequatoria 22: 163-183.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: For Otetela (not Hamba specifically): item I.10 p.172 'Accent d'intensité sur la syllabe du radical (Ainsi en Zone B.)' = Guthrie 1948 Zone C trait translated; Labaere adds no correction (he corrects other items), i.e. tacitly accepts stem-initial stress for Otetela C71.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 2009. Le réseau fluvial congolais et la problématique de l'expansion bantoue. Annales Aequatoria 30: 839-988.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Hamba accent. Cites own Hamba field notes as 'Motingea 2010b' (ms. 'Les langues mɔngɔ du complexe Lomame-Tshuapa'); p.861 tetela-hambá shows eastern features (consonant gemination, NC > C, epenthetic nasal); Hamba examples are morphological; 3.2.2 Tonologie is comparative (ton bas pausal etc.) without naming Hamba.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 2007. Minorités linguistiques au programme de recherche du Centre Aequatoria. Annales Aequatoria 28: 439-455.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; research-programme statement, Hamba not named.

sources.citation: Lowenga La Wemboloke, O. 2001. Quelques chants du rituel abstentiel 'Ngunda' chez les Atetela. Annales Aequatoria 22: 153-161.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; tone-marked song texts recorded from speakers of Bahamba II chefferie (Lomela), i.e. Hamba-area Otetela; no analysis.

sources.citation: Ohanu wa Kasongo, G.B. 1993. A propos de l'otetela-hamba de Lomela. Annales Aequatoria 14: 535-538.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Dialect inventory of lohambá (8 variants instead of Labaere & Shango's 3), ethnohistory of the name Ahambá, one segmental note (post-nasal stop deletion in the Okâle variant); no tone or accent statement.

sources.citation: Labaere, Hubert & Shango Waato W.L. 1989. Les dialectes otetela. Inventaire. Annales Aequatoria 10: 253-267.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; lists 'LOHAMBA (sud de la forêt équatoriale)' as an Otetela dialect group (Lomela: Ahamba est et ouest, Jeémbó/Dyeémbó, Okale, Shiinkondo; Katako-Kombe; Lodja).

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu. 1989. Esquisse grammaticale du lonkutsu / Sur les parlers nkutsu. Annales Aequatoria 10: 91-116, 269-280 (Glottolog ref 11229 filed under hamb1245).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Describes Nkutu of Lomela (nkut1238), not Hamba; tone only (two tones, pausal tone), no accent statement.

sources.citation: Jacobs, John. 1962. De belangrijkste elementen van het Tetela-toonsysteem (Kasayi-Kivu, Congo). Africana Linguistica 1: 31-42.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Tone only; includes 'het middendeel van het gewest Lomela' in the Tetela-speaking area; no stress/accent statement, none specific to Hamba.

sources.citation: Van Bulck, G. 1948. Les recherches linguistiques au Congo belge. Mém. IRCB XVI. Bruxelles. pp. 508-514 (BaHamba-BaTetela-BaNkutshu group).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
